description: Holds mpds quarterly review header records, linked to financial quarters, financial years, users.
business_purpose: Used to track and report mpds quarterly review header records for the Sales Planning & Performance area.
record_granularity: One row represents one mpds quarterly review header.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Unique identifier of the mpds quarterly review header.

columns.name: userId
columns.description: Reference to the users linked to this mpds quarterly review header.

columns.name: financial_quarterid
columns.description: Reference to the financial quarters linked to this mpds quarterly review header.

columns.name: financial_yearid
columns.description: Reference to the financial years linked to this mpds quarterly review header.

columns.name: Remark
columns.description: Free-text remark for the mpds quarterly review header.

columns.name: created_byId
columns.description: User who created the mpds quarterly review header.

columns.name: created_date
columns.description: Date and time when the record was created.

columns.name: modified_byId
columns.description: User who last modified the mpds quarterly review header.

columns.name: modified_date
columns.description: Date and time when the record was last modified.

columns.name: is_deleted
columns.description: Soft-delete flag. True when the record has been deleted.

relationships.description: Each mpds quarterly review header references one users (user).
Each mpds quarterly review header references one financial quarters (financial quarter).
Each mpds quarterly review header references one financial years (financial year).
User who created the mpds quarterly review header.
User who last modified the mpds quarterly review header.
Each mpds quarterly review header can have many mpds quarterly review details records referencing it through headerid.

business_rules: Deleted records (is_deleted = 1) should normally be excluded from reporting.
created_date is the preferred date column for period-based reporting.
Join to Financial Quarters, Financial Years, Users through the foreign key columns to resolve names.
common_queries: MPDS Quarterly Review Header by month
MPDS Quarterly Review Header by users
MPDS Quarterly Review Header by financial quarters
MPDS Quarterly Review Header by financial years

known_issues: The table appeared empty (estimated 0 rows) when the metadata was last read.

query_notes: The database is MySQL/MariaDB; use MySQL syntax and the exact name MPDSQuarterlyReviewHeader (identifiers can be case-sensitive).
Always filter is_deleted = 0 unless deleted records are explicitly requested.
Use COUNT(DISTINCT id) when counting mpds quarterly review header records; joins can duplicate rows.
To resolve names, join on: userId = Users.Id; financial_quarterid = FinancialQuarters.id; financial_yearid = FinancialYears.id.
